title: Versioned Pre-filter Plan Diff Contract v1.1
description: Canonical contract describing the storage layout, artifact formats, numbered plan view, allowed plan-revision operations and line-numbered diff semantics for versioned Pre-filter plans. Consumed by app.agents.plan_state (Python implementation) and any external validators.

notes: current_plan.md ALWAYS holds the LATEST accepted plan version (canonical source of truth).
Every version is immutable and archived under .ai-agent/plans/v{n}_plan.md.
history.json is the ONLY structured state (versions + diffs); it is upserted on every revision.
The canonical file is derived from history.json (get_current().content) and MUST NOT diverge from it.
Schema version 1.0 history files remain loadable; the module upgrades to 1.1 on persist.

version.description: Monotonic version number. First version is 1.

content.description: Full markdown plan text (the value placed into current_plan.md and v{n}_plan.md).

summary.description: One-line summary of deltas from the previous version (empty on initial version).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the version was registered.

old_start.description: 1-indexed first line in from_version affected by this hunk.

old_lines.description: Number of context+removed lines from from_version. 0 means pure insertion.

new_start.description: 1-indexed first line in to_version affected by this hunk.

new_lines.description: Number of context+added lines in to_version.

lines.description: Unified-diff body lines. Prefixes: ' ' unchanged, '-' removed from from_version, '+' added in to_version.

current_version.description: 0 when no plan exists yet; otherwise the highest accepted version number.

numbered_plan_view.description: Line-numbered rendering of the previous canonical plan that is supplied to Pre-filter planning revisions.
rules: Line numbers are 1-based and zero-padded to 4 digits.
Empty physical lines are still numbered.
Line numbers refer ONLY to the last canonical plan version passed to Pre-filter.
The numbering is advisory for humans/models; it is not part of the canonical plan body.

full_rewrite.description: Return an entirely new canonical plan inside ###Plan##### markers. Always allowed.

replace_range.description: Replace lines [start_line, end_line] (1-based inclusive) of the previous plan with the supplied lines.

insert_before.description: Insert the supplied lines immediately before start_line of the previous plan.

insert_after.description: Insert the supplied lines immediately after end_line of the previous plan.

delete_range.description: Delete lines [start_line, end_line] (1-based inclusive) of the previous plan.

line_ranges.start_rule: start_line must be within the previous plan's physical lines
line_ranges.count_rule: count == 0 means pure insertion at start_line
line_ranges.end_rule: end_line is inclusive; end_line >= start_line for a non-empty range

canonical_body_rules: Full-plan text must be the canonical plan content.
Must NOT include @@ diff headers or '_build_prefilter_advice_section_agent' wrappers.
Must NOT include '[USER PLAN FEEDBACK]' audit markers.

diff_rules.context_verification: Context and removal lines MUST match the previous plan line-for-line after stripping only the unified-diff prefix.
notes: hunk start/count are 1-based inclusive against the previous plan.
Trailing newline preservation and CRLF/CR normalization are tolerated; no other content normalization is applied.

error_rules.requirement: All invalid cases must produce a PlanUpdateResult with success=false, mode='error', a populated error string, and MUST NOT cause any partial write to current_plan.md.

canonical_file_rules.content: Only the latest canonical plan body (no markers, no wrappers, no diff hunks).

display_rules.tui_cli: TUI and CLI MUST display the full updated canonical plan without truncation.
display_rules.downstream: Orchestrator and Tester MUST receive the latest accepted canonical plan formatted through the existing advisory wrapper (never a raw diff-only response).
